disciplines.mechanism: Expected-R band in [-5,+5] plus a closed predicate vocabulary, sealed before the outcome; the resolver scores every claim as a prereg_score row.
disciplines.name: Pre-registration

disciplines.mechanism: build_packet(as_of=T) admits no bar, headline, or event newer than T; max_data_ts is sealed in the record as proof.
disciplines.name: Point-in-time packets

disciplines.mechanism: 3 directives per session; a 2nd same-group interrupt inside 30 min pauses instead of averaging. Emission refused, judgment still sealed.
disciplines.name: Caps & co-drift

disciplines.mechanism: The veto book is the book of record — bounded downside, cleanest edge signal. Full discretion stays unbuilt.
disciplines.name: Referee first

disciplines.mechanism: gap_log.py matches trade_ids across sim and paper ledgers; widening drift beyond 0.05R blocks the promotion report.
disciplines.name: Sim→live gap tripwire

disciplines.mechanism: One yield row per session (veto R − baseline R); three monotone declines print YIELD_DECAY. Demotion readable from data.
disciplines.name: Yield curve

disciplines.mechanism: --shadow: full judgment, sealed record, forecast — zero directive bytes. Excluded from the session cap.
disciplines.name: Shadow soak
